# ANALYSIS: VIX_RANGE_FILTER_15_25_STAGE1

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** stage1_backtest  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Testing whether restricting entries to VIX range [15,25] improves edge capture on J anchor days by filtering out low-VIX complacency and high-VIX panic environments, while preserving the core BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup's validity on the 3 winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and reducing losses on the 3 loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07).

## Mechanism

Apply a pre-entry filter: only allow BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setups when the VIX value (from the same bar as entry trigger) is between 15.0 and 25.0 inclusive. All other engine parameters (strike selection, stops, targets, management) remain unchanged. This filter is evaluated at the exact trigger bar time using the VIX value from the data feed.

## OP-20 style disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Analysis assumes Safe-2 account size ($2K) for contract sizing; $1K paper account would realize ~34% of headline P&L (3 contracts at $2K scales to 1.5 contracts at $1K, floored to 3 contracts via risk rules min lot).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 uses full available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) in-sample; high overfit risk due to no walk-forward separation yet. Sample size ~345 trading days; selection method is VIX range filter applied universally.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not performed; task requires OOS after Stage-1).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills check on top 3 J days not performed; task requires it after Stage-1).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Filter may reject valid low-VIX (<15) bearish rejection setups (e.g., 2025-Q4 low-VIX regime) turning winners into losers.
   - Max drawdown: If VIX range [15,25] misses explosive moves (VIX>25), could increase losing streak length during volatility expansion.
   - Blow-up scenario: Persistent VIX<15 market (low volatility chop) causing chronic false triggers and premium decay from repeated small losses.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
- Gym validators: All strategy/autoresearch/gym_*.py tests must PASS.
- Walk-forward: OOS Sharpe ratio >= 0.70 on 6-month held-out window (2026-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with per-month rate consistency (train/test ratio >=0.6).
- Real-fills: Top 3 J day P&L deviation from BS-sim must be < ±20% using REAL_OPRA_SIM.
- Anchor no-regression: All 3 PUT winner days must show non-negative delta vs baseline (engine must not skip or lose on any winner day).
- OP-16 edge_capture: Must exceed 771 (50% of max 1542) to avoid REJECTION.

3 / 10 -- No backtest results available; pure hypothesis. VIX range [15,25] is arbitrary without prior validation. High risk of overfitting to recent VIX regimes.
